senses.gloss:
__1 Evil doing, wickedness. 
__2 Repentance. 
-कौक्कुट a. [कुक्कुट-अण्] Relating to a cock; [[Rām. 2. 91. 70.]]

[कुक्कुट-ठक्] 
__1 A poulterer. 
__2 A mendicant who walks always fixing his eyes on the ground for fear of treading upon worms, insects &c. 
__3 (Hence) A hypocrite.

a. (-क्षी f.) 
__1 Tied to, or being on the sides. 
__2 Abdominal.

(-यी f.) [कुक्षि-ठञ्] 
__1 Being in the belly. 
__2 Being in a sheath; असिं कौक्षेयमुद्यम्य चकारापनसं मुखम् [[Bk. 4. 31.]]
[कुक्षौ बद्धोऽसिः ढकञ् cf. [[P. IV. 2. 96.]]] A sword, scimitar; वामपार्श्वावलम्बिना कौक्षेयकेण [[K. 8]]; [[Vikr. 1. 90]]; आधावन्तः संमुखं धारितानामन्यैरन्ये तीक्ष्णकौक्षेयकाणाम् [[Śi. 18. 17.]]
